From: Dana Whitfield
To: Gabriel Fontes, Victor Alade
Subject: Question on Monthly Close Package – Line Item Review

Hi Gabriel, Victor,

I’m reviewing this month’s close package and have a question on the line item for [specific line item – please insert description or reference]. The number doesn’t align with my expectations based on the prior period trend, and I want to make sure we’re capturing everything correctly before we finalize.

Can you both take a quick look and confirm the breakdown or flag if there’s an adjustment we missed? I’d like to close this out by end of day tomorrow if possible.

Thanks,
Dana

---

From: Gabriel Fontes
To: Dana Whitfield
Subject: Re: Question on Monthly Close Package – Line Item Review

Hi Dana,

Thanks for flagging this. I’ve gone back through the line item you referenced, and here’s the breakdown:

The variance versus the prior period trend is almost entirely driven by a late-September material cost spike. That accounts for roughly 1.1 of the 1.2 percentage points in the gross margin movement; the remaining 0.1 point is minor and within normal noise. Freight is immaterial to this change.

I can send a more detailed split by SKU if helpful, or we can walk through it together. I’m available for a quick call whenever works for you.

Happy to close this out by tomorrow.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes

---

Victor's confirmation on his queue will give us full visibility, but from my side, there are no other adjustments booked for this line item.

I've also sent a calendar invite for the 8:30 walk-through tomorrow — I'll bring the SKU-level detail and freight comparison to support your board commentary.

Let me know if anything else would help before you finalize.

Confirming alignment with Gabriel's assessment. I've checked my queue—no freight, no other adjustments, nothing sitting against this line item. The 1.2-point variance is fully attributable to the late-September material cost spike; the remaining ~0.1 point is rounding/timing noise.
